靳兰玦将发现告诉光头：

“你来听声音指方向，我帮你看着路，我们再试试。”

光头狐疑：“你是不是编谎话吓唬我呢？”

靳兰玦故意摆出骄横的脾气：“那算了，我自己走。”

说完真的扭头就走。

光头一听她来真的，立刻叫她回去。

靳兰玦有心让这恶人吃吃苦头，故意不停，一心就往刚才他指的方向走。

光头急了，跌跌撞撞追上来，被林立的枯树撞了好几下。

最后一次撞得最狠，直接鼻血长流。

他捂着鼻子痛得抓狂骂人，又得忍气吞声哄着靳兰玦：

“我错了我错了，听你的就是了，快点回来，我看不见路！

你是菩萨心肠，就当可怜可怜我这个瞎子行不行？”

靳兰玦冷眼看着他狼狈的样子，声音轻飘飘的：“指路。”

光头憋屈得不行，咬肌鼓了又鼓，还是指出方向来。

这一次两人不再绕圈子，开始前进。

远处的尖叫声已经停止，靳兰玦无从分辨刚才的那几人在哪里。

她需要更多的信息。

在遇到其他人之前，只能先带着光头。

只是她心中一直提防着光头，毕竟他脑子里钻进去那么大一条蛇，不可能真的一点事儿没有。

随着两人慢慢朝山顶上进发，靳兰玦总觉得身后有什么东西在窸窸窣窣。

但是每次她回头，又是一片寂静。

寒风轻拂，树影幢幢。

阴冷的气息无孔不入，靳兰玦此时已经又冷又饿，虚弱得每一步都拖在地上。

鞋尖上，已经堆了厚厚一层脏兮兮的泥巴。

她突发奇想。

虽然系统没有回应她的呼叫，但她可以直接吩咐随行直播开启。

那么，是不是其他的技能她也可以直接使用？

自己手头，现在有四个技能。

预言吉凶，属于被动技能，在可以预言的事件即将发生前，她的面前会出现系统的面板提示。

Jin Lanjue told the bald head what he found:

"You listen to the voice and give directions, and I'll help you look at the road. Let's try again."

The bald man was suspicious: "Are you making up lies to scare me?"

Jin Lanjue deliberately showed off his arrogant temper: "Forget it, I'll go by myself."

After saying that, he really turned around and left.

When the bald man heard that she was serious, he immediately asked her to go back.

Jin Lanjue was determined to make this evil man suffer, and he deliberately kept walking in the direction he pointed just now.

Baldhead became anxious and stumbled after him, but was hit several times by the dead trees standing in the forest.

The last collision was the hardest, causing my nose to bleed.

He held his nose in pain and cursed like crazy, but he had to swallow his anger and coax Jin Lanjue:

"I was wrong, I was wrong, just listen to you, come back quickly, I can't see the road!

You have a Bodhisattva heart, so just take pity on me, a blind man, okay?"

Jin Lanjue looked at his embarrassed look with cold eyes, and said in a light voice: "Show me the way."

The bald head was so suffocated that his masseter muscles bulged again and again, but he still pointed out the direction.

This time the two stopped going around in circles and started moving forward.

The screams in the distance have stopped, and Jin Lanjue can't tell where the people just now are.

She needs more information.

You can only go with your bald head until you meet other people.

But she was always wary of the bald head. After all, with such a big snake worming its way into his head, it was impossible for him to be completely fine.

As the two of them slowly headed towards the top of the mountain, Jin Lanjue always felt like there was something rustling behind him.

But every time she looked back, there was silence again.

The cold wind blows gently, and the shadows of the trees are scattered.

The cold breath was pervasive, and Jin Lanjue was already cold and hungry, so weak that every step he took was dragging on the ground.

There was already a thick layer of dirty mud on the toes of the shoes.

An idea struck her.

Although the system did not respond to her call, she could directly instruct the accompanying live broadcast to start.

So, can she also use other skills directly?

I have four skills at my disposal now.

Predicting good or bad luck is a passive skill. Before a foreseeable event is about to happen, a system panel prompt will appear in front of her.
